All gates pass. The work is complete. Here's the summary.

## Result
- Goal/task: G-20260729T065622761503Z-4479b0d3 / **T-20260729T065622770500Z-513839f0**
- Role: Implementer (Claude Code)

## What changed
Required the CCA to evaluate *every* blocking checklist item and acceptance criterion even when a blocker is already known, and made the enforcer reject a verdict that short-circuits with an "already blocked" reason.

- **`scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.py`** — new `short_circuited_evaluations()` + `_is_already_blocked_reason()`, wired into `validate_verdict()` to raise on any blocking checklist item or acceptance criterion left `insufficient_evidence` with an "already blocked / verdict already determined / not evaluated because a blocker exists" reason. Detection is a **two-signal** design (strong standalone phrase, OR skip-signal + already-blocked-external-cause) so it does *not* false-positive on genuine reasons that name their own missing evidence.
- **`.github/prompts/cca-completion-check.md`** — added judgment rules instructing the judge to evaluate every blocking item even when one already fails, to not use "already blocked" style reasons (the enforcer rejects them), and to reserve `insufficient_evidence` for genuinely-missing evidence; clarified the "stop reading" line so bounding *reading* never licenses skipping *evaluation*.
- **`tests/test_cca_completeness.py`** (new) — 11 tests: short-circuit detection + variants, acceptance-criterion coverage, non-blocking exclusion, integration rejection (mutation guard), accept-a-fully-evaluated-blocked-verdict, and adversarial genuine-reason near-misses that must stay accepted; plus prompt-instruction assertions.
- **`scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh`** — two shell fixtures: a short-circuited verdict is rejected (`blocking evaluation short-circuited`); a fully-evaluated `blocked` verdict passes validation yet still blocks MergeGate.

## Acceptance checks — all met
- ✅ Short-circuited blocking item → rejected by enforcer (`test_short_circuited_blocking_item_is_rejected`, shell fixture).
- ✅ Fully-evaluated blocking items → accepted regardless of verdict value (`test_fully_evaluated_blocked_verdict_is_accepted`, shell fixture).
- ✅ Prompt instructs evaluating every blocking item even when one already fails.
- ✅ Mutation guard: removing the rejection fails 2 unittests **and** the control-plane shell test (verified both directions).
